visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black long-sleeved top and black trousers, is seen kneeling on a polished dark wooden floor. She is facing a young girl who is standing and wearing brown pajamas with a repeating gold pattern. The setting is a dimly lit bedroom or living room with a white radiator against a light-colored wall. A single pendant light glows from the ceiling, casting soft, warm light over the scene. (2) The scene abruptly cuts to a bright, close-up shot of an infant with chubby cheeks and dark hair. The baby is laughing joyfully while being held by an unseen adult. The baby wears a striped green and white bib and a light-colored onesie. The background is a slightly out-of-focus indoor environment with a purple wall. (3) The view returns to the original room. A young boy in a light pink t-shirt and red shorts walks into the frame and sits on the kneeling woman's lap. The woman continues to hold the girl's hands while looking at her, maintaining an intimate and focused family interaction. (4) A new brief clip shows a baby sitting in a light green high chair, wearing a dark blue patterned bib. A hand holding a small white bowl of orange-colored puree feeds the baby with a yellow spoon. (5) The video returns to the woman and the two older children. They are clustered together on the floor. The woman is still kneeling, speaking softly to the girl who stands before her. The boy remains on her lap. (6) A quick cut shows a toddler in a grey short-sleeved onesie walking across a wooden floor towards a dark brown wooden TV cabinet. Wires are visible hanging from the back of the TV. (7) Back in the main scene, the woman continues her dialogue with the girl. The girl listens intently, her expression serious. The boy on the woman's lap shifts slightly. (8) The woman stands up, exerting physical effort to lift the girl into her arms. The girl wraps her legs around the woman's waist and her arms around the woman's neck. Four yellow crying emojis appear at the bottom center of the screen. (9) The woman holds the girl tightly while walking slowly. The boy approaches them, raising his arms as if asking for attention. The woman turns slightly, looking down at the boy while still holding the girl.
